prompt:
Create a polished anime-style vertical magazine-cover poster about a gender-swap before/after transformation. The main focus is a beautiful androgynous teen boy version of the original character, posed large on the right side like a fashion magazine cover, with the same recognizable features preserved: Nozomu, bright blue eyes, soft light ash-blond tousled hair, fair skin, gentle smile, airy youthful expression, and delicate facial features. He wears a loose white shirt with slightly sheer fabric, pale blue tie or ribbon hanging undone, blue suspenders, silver chain accessories, earrings, bracelet, and a blue belt, giving a cool elegant prince-like look. His pose is relaxed, one hand near his chin, upper body angled slightly forward, with windblown hair strands and soft petals floating around.

Canvas: Vertical 4:5 poster, bright pastel blue-and-white palette, high-key lighting, dreamy bokeh background, soft floral sparkle atmosphere, delicate shoujo-anime rendering, crisp line art, luminous eyes, transparent watercolor shading, magazine-cover composition.

Layout: Place exactly 1 small “Before” card in the upper left showing the original girl version. The card has rounded corners, a thin blue border, and a blue tab label at the top reading 「元の姿」. Inside the card, show a cute blonde girl with the same blue eyes, wearing a white blouse and blue plaid dress or skirt, smiling brightly. At the bottom of the card write 「のぞむ」. The large “After” character occupies the right two-thirds of the poster and overlaps the typography slightly.

Text content: Add large Japanese headline typography on the left and center: 「この子、男の子になったら。」 with 「男の子」 especially large and blue while the rest is black calligraphy-style text. Beneath it add the smaller subtitle 「面影そのまま、性別だけ反転。」 with a thin blue underline flourish. Add a circular blue stamp near the lower right of the headline, overlapping the character, reading 「男女反転」 with small sparkle marks. Add a bottom tagline in small Japanese text: 「可愛さを残した、最高にかっこいい彼。」 with the phrase 「最高にかっこいい」 in blue.

Style constraints: Keep the image clean and premium, like a Japanese light-novel or fashion magazine advertisement. Use elegant Japanese typography, soft gradients, pastel blues, floating white petals, and bright rim light. Do not add extra characters, extra cards, watermarks, logos, or clutter. Preserve exactly 1 before card, 1 main after character, 1 circular stamp, 1 large headline, 1 subtitle, and 1 bottom tagline.
